name: Deceased Loved Ones
overview: Scripture teaches that while death is certain and the dead no longer know or receive reward (Ecclesiastes 9:5), believers find comfort in the Lord as their shepherd who provides and cares for them (Psalms 23:1). God’s love offers eternal life through faith in Jesus Christ, who is the only way to the Father (John 3:16; John 14:6). Christians are called to live in a way that glorifies God, reflecting His light in the world (Matthew 5:16), and to avoid seeking guidance from spirits or wizards, which defiles (Leviticus 19:31).
